limits: Entirely redrawn independent native pixel-art bodies of this exact incarnation; no derived pixel filter or source bitmap downsampling.

Standard adult gray/cream unarmored quadruped, anatomical RIGHT patch visible in right view, anatomical LEFT eye uncovered in left view. No armor, handheld weapon or human limb. Natural four legs may be partly occluded in side view.
Source body datum is the trunk midpoint between shoulders and hips, excluding muzzle/tail, not the whole bounding rectangle.
No directly attested metre height was established; preserved historical animal framing remains estimated, not recertified as absolute1:1.
